item.title: SUCSU election Tuesday after 28 years, security to be strengthen

item.title: MASTUL Foundation hosted by Zakat Conference 2026 in Dhaka

item.title: Arrest warrants against Shamim Osman, 11 others
item.description: The International Crimes Tribunal on Monday issued arrest warrants against former Narayanganj-4 MP Shamim Osman, his son Ayon Osman and 10 others over crimes against humanity committed during the July movement in Narayanganj.The tribunal judge issued this order accepting the charges submitted earlier this morning by Gazi Monwar Hussain.Shamim Osman, a senior Awami League leader, previously served as a member of parliament from the Narayanganj-4 constituency. item.title: 90th birth anniv of BNP founder Prez Ziaur Rahman today

item.title: Students' union and hall polls at SUST stayed
item.description: The High Court on Monday stayed Shahjalal University of Science and Technology's central students' union (SUCSU) election scheduled for Tuesday (January 20).Following a writ, a two-member HC bench of Justice Fahmida Quader and Justice Md Asif Hasan issued this order. Barrister Ruhul Quddus Kajol, Barrister Rashna Imam, Barrister Moniruzzamana Asad were present on behalf of the petitioner.Barrister Rashna Imam said SUCSU election will be held any time after four weeks.TF
